text: Past medical history: Currently being treated for community-acquired pneumonia. No other significant past medical history. Social history: Non-smoker, does not consume alcohol. No recent travel or dietary changes reported.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your recent antibiotic use and symptoms, C. difficile infection remains the primary concern despite the inconclusive toxin test. I will request a more sensitive diagnostic test to confirm the presence of the bacteria. REQUEST TEST: Stool_C_Difficile_PCR

speaker: Doctor
text: The PCR result confirms a Clostridioides difficile infection, so I will immediately discontinue the levofloxacin and initiate oral vancomycin treatment. Please let me know if you experience any worsening of abdominal pain or signs of dehydration.

speaker: Patient
text: No fever, no recent antibiotics usage apart from levofloxacin for pneumonia, no vomiting, no blood in stool.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming those details; the absence of fever and blood helps rule out more severe complications like toxic megacolon. Since the diagnosis is confirmed and treatment has been initiated, I will now finalize the assessment. DIAGNOSIS READY: Clostridioides difficile infection
